{"title": "Obtain reset notice and loan documents", "text": "Obtain the mortgage reset notice, the current loan statement, and the original adjustable-rate note for Dorian Pebblefizz's first mortgage with Teacup Comet Bank. {"title": "Prepare servicer information request", "text": "Prepare a concise information request for Teacup Comet Bank, the mortgage servicer, asking for the written modification estimate that was promised but not sent after Dorian Pebblefizz was transferred between departments twice.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-02-19", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "so the agreed follow-up is to prepare a concise information request for the servicer by February 19, 2024."},
{"title": "Complete mortgage escrow discrepancy check", "text": "Reconcile the different escrow amounts shown on the reset notice and the online mortgage portal for Dorian Pebblefizz's Teacup Comet Bank first mortgage, since the difference creates a payment discrepancy that must be resolved before relying on the projected post-reset payment.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-02-23", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "the agreed follow-up is to complete the mortgage escrow discrepancy check by February 23, 2024."},
{"title": "Verify recent income and pay statements", "text": "Verify current proof of income for the refinance package by obtaining Dorian Pebblefizz's most recent Moonbadger Systems pay statement and Lena Pebblefizz's Paper Otter Health Cooperative pay statement, which have not yet been uploaded.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-02-21", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to verify recent income and pay statements by February 21, 2024."},
{"title": "Update household profile", "text": "Refresh the household profile for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz with current employment, income, dependent, and family support details. {"title": "Compare HELOC repayment options", "text": "Compare keeping the home equity line of credit separate, rolling it into a refinance, or using a scheduled principal repayment plan for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz. {"title": "Prepare credit card payoff sequence", "text": "Prepare a payoff order for the three credit cards totaling $22,700 for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz, showing interest cost, minimum-payment requirements, and the effect of applying the possible $900 per month reduction in travel and dining spending to the highest-rate card first. {"title": "Reconcile credit report balance", "text": "Reconcile the credit card balance on the lender's credit report that is about $2,100 higher than the current online balance for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz, checking refinance debt-to-income inputs against updated statements.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-02-27", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to complete that credit report balance reconciliation by February 27, 2024."},
{"title": "Prepare cash-flow triage budget", "text": "Prepare a temporary cash-flow triage budget for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz identifying spending reductions, debt-payment targets, and a minimum cash reserve guardrail. {"title": "Prepare bonus and RSU allocation plan", "text": "Prepare a written allocation framework for Dorian Pebblefizz's next bonus and restricted stock unit vesting that balances tax withholding, credit card payoff, cash reserve protection, and possible refinance closing costs. {"title": "Model equity income tax adjustments", "text": "Model Dorian Pebblefizz's upcoming Moonbadger Systems restricted stock unit income for possible estimated tax or withholding adjustments, since RSU withholding may be below the household's marginal tax rate. {"title": "Complete insurance premium pressure review", "text": "Review the Amber Teapot Mutual homeowners coverage pages, deductible options, and whether the mortgage escrow projection reflects the new premium for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz. {"title": "Complete estate document relevance check", "text": "Review beneficiary designations and estate-document topics to raise with an attorney for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz.
